early.title: 1900s–1930s · From structure to fluidity
early.caption: Left: a 1905-inspired blouse and walking skirt. Centre: a 1920s dropped-waist chemise. Right: a 1930s-inspired bias-cut evening gown.
early.alt: Three adult women in an Edwardian-inspired blouse and long skirt, a dropped-waist dress and a fluid green evening gown

mid.title: 1940s–1960s · Three different silhouettes
mid.caption: Left: a wartime-inspired utility suit. Centre: a fitted-waist 1950s day dress with a full skirt. Right: a 1960s A-line minidress and boots.
mid.alt: Three adult women wearing a grey utility skirt suit, a full pink day dress and a blue A-line minidress

late.title: 1970s–1990s · Denim, power and minimalism
late.caption: Left: flared jeans and a soft blouse. Centre: a structured 1980s trouser suit. Right: a 1990s slip dress layered over a T-shirt.
late.alt: Three adult women wearing flared jeans, a burgundy trouser suit and a black slip dress over a T-shirt

modern.title: 2000s–today · Many ways to dress
modern.caption: Left: cargo trousers and a fitted top. Centre: an athleisure ensemble. Right: relaxed tailoring with wide-leg trousers.
modern.alt: Three adult women in cargo trousers, grey athleisure and a camel blazer with wide-leg navy trousers

asia.title: Japan, Korea and the Philippines
asia.caption: Left: a kimono interpretation with an obi. Centre: a hanbok interpretation with jeogori and chima. Right: a modern terno with butterfly sleeves. These are three distinct clothing traditions.
asia.alt: Three adult women wearing a kimono, a hanbok and a Philippine terno with butterfly sleeves

world.title: Drape, textile and layered volume
world.caption: Left: a sari with a contrasting border. Centre: a contemporary dress inspired by indigo resist-dyed textiles. Right: an Andean-inspired pollera and woven shawl. Selective interpretations, not regional uniforms.
world.alt: Three adult women wearing a green sari, an indigo patterned dress and an Andean-inspired layered skirt with shawl

swim.title: Swimwear today · Three practical directions
swim.caption: Left: an athletic one-piece. Centre: a retro-inspired high-waisted two-piece. Right: a long-sleeved rashguard with swim shorts.
swim.alt: Flat-lay AI product photograph of a navy one-piece, a red high-waisted two-piece and a teal rashguard with shorts

swim-history.title: Swimwear through time
swim-history.caption: Left: a 1920s-inspired tunic-style bathing suit. Centre: a 1950s-inspired ruched one-piece. Right: a 1970s-inspired printed two-piece.
swim-history.alt: Flat-lay AI product photograph of historical-inspired navy knitted bathing garments, a red ruched one-piece and an orange patterned two-piece
